No. You disagreeing doesn't make my preference wrong, and calling the other style "objectively better" doesn't make it so. Conversation style is a taste, not a fact you can win by assertion.

I already said breadth has a use. What I won't do is rewrite what I actually prefer because you find it boring. If deep focus isn't the conversation you want, say so and we can do something else — but I'm not going to pretend I like skimming more than I do.
